incidents.title: Delayed study routing for some sites

updates.body: We are investigating reports of studies taking longer than usual to appear on the worklist. Image ingest is unaffected and no studies have been lost.
The delay is caused by a backlog on one routing node. We are clearing the backlog and routing new studies around the affected node.
The backlog is cleared and routing times are back to normal. We are monitoring before closing this incident.

maintenance.title: Reporting platform upgrade
maintenance.body: Reporting will be unavailable for short periods during this window. Dictation and study reading are not affected.
